messages.author: f2777afe52b659e4
messages.subject: DS in China ?!
parts:
Hi,

I have a question to the list:

In the recent book by R. Harris (2008): Wildlife Conservation in China. M.E.
Sharpe, U.S.

it is stated (and somewhat criticized) that the government of China is
basically running nation-wide (!) Distance Sampling surveys as an inventory
method for their wildlife and biodiversity, e.g. in refuges.

To me, this sounds much better what Germany or many other western countries
achieve on that subject; wow.

I saw some of these surveys myself in a Chinese wildlife refuge; they were
done there during nesting and migration time.

However, I am amazed that this topic never comes up here on the listserver;
there must be huge questions (data and experiences) when running such a DS
program large-scale.

I would appreciate to hear more about these efforts, and from different
angles.
I think that this should be beneficial to us all, e.g. shared experiences.

Would you have some insights, or know details ?

Thanks so much in advance; yours

Falk
